name: Pass-Y for Vaultwarden
subtitle: Passwords on your own server
promotionalText: A calm, native password manager for your own Vaultwarden server. No account with us, no ads, no tracking.
description:
Pass-Y is a native password manager for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch that connects to your own Vaultwarden server or another Bitwarden-compatible server. You enter your server address and your vault stays on your server.

You need an account on such a server. Pass-Y does not host vaults and does not offer accounts of its own.

PASSWORDS AND MORE
- Logins, cards, identities, secure notes and SSH keys
- Folders, favorites, search and trash
- Password and passphrase generator
- Attachments and Send for sharing text and files
- Organizations and collections

SIGN IN FASTER
- AutoFill in Safari and apps
- Passkeys
- Verification codes (TOTP), also on Apple Watch
- Unlock with Face ID, Touch ID or a PIN

MADE FOR APPLE DEVICES
- A clean, native design with light and dark mode and Dynamic Type
- Arrange the vault page your way: cards, folders, sections and colors
- Optionally keep that layout in your own iCloud

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no analytics, no tracking
- No in-app purchases, no subscription
- Open source under the GNU GPL v3: https://github.com/enrzh/pass-y

Pass-Y is an independent open-source project based on the Bitwarden iOS client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Bitwarden, Inc. or the Vaultwarden project.

Support: support@aiity.de
